segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report good hydration without added shine or heaviness, and one notes it made her partner's oily skin more oily.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe strong, lasting hydration, plumping and improved smoothness, with several calling it a staple for winter dryness.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally tolerate the serum well, though one with combo/acne-prone skin reports painful breakouts and dark spots.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many praise it as fragrance-free and non-irritating even for rosacea or eczema-prone skin, while others report breakouts or whiteheads with frequent use.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes herself as an older woman and appreciates the plumping effect on mature skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention reduced appearance of fine lines and a firming, plumping effect on the skin.
concerns.dehydration: Hydration is the most consistently praised effect, with reviewers across skin types reporting plumper, softer, less dry skin, including one using it on dry lips and another after starting a drying medication.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers report reduced redness or soothed rosacea, but one reviewer noted new redness appearing after use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the serum with repairing or protecting the skin barrier, especially after damage from other actives like squalane.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report reduced dark spots or brightened discoloration, though one reviewer reports new dark spots left behind by breakouts caused by the product.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are sharply divided: several acne-prone reviewers say it caused no new breakouts and even calmed their skin, while multiple others describe new comedones, painful cystic pimples, or breakouts lasting weeks, some stopping use as a result.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the serum feels non-greasy and helps with hydration without excess shine, though one reviewer noted it made another person's skin more oily.

aspects.libelle: Works well as makeup primer base

extraits.texte: Was really hoping it wasnt this product that was causing acne because it does give the most beautiful glass skin but after isolating products and even trying to incorporate it back in it was 100% causing pimples and not just my normal size ones.. very painful and left the worst dark spots once i did get them healed :( i have combo and sensitive/acne probe skin so maybe consider if you have the same skin type

As someone with acne prone skin, I love this serum. Snail musin broke me out so bad. I've been looking for something to lock in mositure and help repair my skin barrier. This is my third prepurchase and I cannot say enough good things about this product!!

extraits.titre: Yes & More yes & then add'l yes
extraits.texte: I love this serum. I have been on a long journey of finding products (& wasted tons of dollars) that don't irritate my sensitive skin (acne, combo, hives). Little goes a long way. AM & PM. Fragrance FREE (thank you)!! Please don't change it.

I'm a woman in my early twenties, my skin has been beginning to change/flare up as if I'm hitting puberty again (ugh not a fan)- this product perfect to soothe my rosacea on my cheeks and my sensitive skin in general.. I'm a sucker for a good glow too

I have very dry acne prone skin that gets angry at most products. Generally my forehead and in er area if cheeks are dry, with my nose and chin prone to breakouts/blackheads. I seriously have achieved "glass skin" with this. It will feel slightly tacky but dried quickly. I layer with a gel moisturizer, sunscreen serum, and makeup. I haven't had an any issues with how my makeup looks. I love that it's a vegan version too.

I'm on my fourth bottle and have bought it for friends as well. I have very dry, sensitive skin and this is like magic for my skin, I even pat it on my dry lips! I can't speak to it being okay for acne-prone skin, as I am not. But its a great staple to have around for hydration. I use one and a half pumps and pat it into my skin rather than rubbing. It has a slight tackiness to it. It's been amazing under makeup as well. Will be buying this for life.

I found this serum particularly sticky. It felt like it sat on my face to give that "glass skin" sheen and didn't actually absorb or do anything. I tried it alone without any other products and in the morning my face had some redness and didn't really notice any groundbreaking changes. I feel that its maybe gimmicky since it leaves your skin shiny, its the allusion of creating glass skin, but after you wash it off your skin is the same. This is the fourth or fifth product ive tried from Byoma and they all have been misses. I'd rather spend $5-$10 more on products , and get one that actually works.
